debate_verdicts.evidence: debate_analysis L2 (scenario=stats_design) 裁决 modify/confidence=medium。裁决依据：正方挂 MDES=1.796、power=0.198、CI 上界 3.220>MDES 证明 naive p=0.215 不能作阴性；反方指出事后分层未预注册、缺批次元数据，故分层 p<1e-6 亦不能作确认阳性。rubrics: power_error_control=9, data_integrity=8, effect_robustness=7, multiplicity_grading=7, confounding_structure=
